fields.summary: Project setup, rules, and documentation scaffold
fields.description: Create repository governance and documentation needed to connect Jira, GitHub, and seminar evidence.
acceptance_criteria: README explains how to run the agent.
PR template requires a URIZ Jira key.
Commit hook rejects messages without a Jira key.

fields.description: Load Jira work items and GitHub development activity for backlog and traceability audits.
Implement multi-step backlog QA workflow with deterministic and LLM-assisted analysis.
Generate JSON and Markdown reports for PM, PO, QA, and seminar review.
Validate the agent on weak story, linked story, and risk/testability scenarios.
Keep SRS, Jira backlog, traceability matrix, and repository documentation aligned.

fields.summary: As a project manager, I want repository governance rules, so that every code change is traceable to Jira.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a commit message without a URIZ key, when the validator runs, then it fails.
- Given a PR title with a URIZ key, when the PR is reviewed, then it satisfies the naming rule.
Import Jira stuff and make it better and easy.

fields.summary: As a product owner, I want story quality analysis, so that weak backlog items are found before sprint planning.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a Jira story with no acceptance criteria, when audit runs, then the report flags it.
- Given a vague story, when audit runs, then the report suggests a measurable rewrite.

fields.summary: As a project manager, I want traceability checks, so that Jira tasks can be connected to GitHub work.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given branches or commits with URIZ keys, when audit runs, then linked issues are not reported as gaps.
- Given an issue with no GitHub evidence, when audit runs, then the report lists a traceability gap.
The feature reads API token and repository metadata.

fields.summary: As a QA engineer, I want JSON and Markdown reports, so that findings can be reviewed and reused as test evidence.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an audit run, when it finishes, then audit.json is created.
- Given an audit run, when it finishes, then audit.md contains summary, risks, test cases and traceability gaps.

fields.summary: As a student team, we want SRS documentation aligned with code, so that homework and seminar artifacts are consistent.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given the repository documentation, when reviewed, then it references Jira epics and stories.
- Given the SRS document, when reviewed, then it explains users, scope, functionality, NFRs, external services and technologies.
